summary: Two SQL Developer Resumes against Management and Testing.
job_description:
Version 1 is hiring an Oracle PL/SQL Developer to write and tune the stored procedures a high-volume transactional system runs on.

What we need:
- 4+ years PL/SQL development
- PL/SQL
- SQL
- Database tuning

The original posting also asked for the following, which this demo does not gate on: Enterprise source control experience; Database tuning and performance monitoring; Data modelling and design; Effective written and oral communication; Oracle; APEX; OAP; Data modelling; Version control.
